title: Three-agency isolation end-to-end test (Tier 1 exit)
goal: Prove in the real app that three agencies on three plans cannot see each other's leads, files, settings or live updates.
why: Program plan W3 and Tier 1 exit: "three-agency isolation e2e passes"; nothing tests isolation end to end today (platform.tenant-isolation was broken).
steps: helpers/tenants.ts: createSuperAdminToken(apiUrl) (via the TEST_MODE route R113 added, or SQL through a test route), createAgency(apiUrl, token, { plan, slug }) -> { tenantId, adminEmail, tempPassword } (POST /admin/tenants), firstLogin(page, agency) (outbox password -> change password -> skip onboarding).

tenant-isolation.spec.ts (serial): on a --multi slot (pool 4: demo + 3), create agencies A (basic), B (pro), C (enterprise); each admin creates a lead with a unique name, uploads a file, sets company name; API checks with A's token: GET B's lead id -> 404; list leads never contains B/C names; GET and DELETE B's file key -> 403; GET /settings returns A's company only; WebSocket: open A's and B's sockets (same URL pattern the desktop uses), create a lead in B, assert A receives no message within 3 s while B does; UI check: A's leads page shows only A's lead; plan gates: A (basic) gets 403 upgrade on an AI route, C does not.
Run three times in a row on a reset DB (program plan W5 rule for stability) and record the results.
acceptance: tenant-isolation.spec.ts passes three consecutive runs on `fix-stack up --slot 1 --reset-db --multi`.
The Tier 1 exit list in READINESS-PLAN section 1 is re-run and recorded by the orchestrator.
